scope: Automatic physical corners fixed before solving. Compare no inset with 1% per side, alternating order. The import dialog supplies a binary mask to fitting. Common error maps independent exports into the unchanged original photograph interior, excluding 3% on each side; it is not ground truth. Different own-target errors are not directly comparable. Timings exclude detection and external rendering. No model training or reference templates.
decision: Do not enable an unconditional default inset. All 26 inputs pass in both arms, but common-interior error worsens on 24/26 cases. Original physical corners remain the production default; the helper and experiment permit further targeted work.
runtimeNote: The measured runtime includes the experimental unconditional default adapter, but the experiment reads raw locator corners and applies each arm explicitly. That default adapter was subsequently withheld; its exact measured hash remains in sourceHashes.
